Preparing before arriving at the skyport will keep your animal acceptance smooth and the check-in line moving.

Travel Notice for Animal Carriage

Travelers must bring the correct crate, documents, and care details before arrival. The Companion Animal Travel Desk reviews each case on the spot, and the ground team moves carriers carefully between services. Staff record service changes in the desk ledger so the handoff remains clear.

For reptile travel, please note <<FACT F060>> and keep the animal secured for inspection. For large dog travel, please note <<FACT F069>> and present the crate in sound condition with room for safe handling. Nora Martin and Elena Nakamura should use the same process as any other traveler, and Riley must stay contained until staff give instructions.

Keep labels legible, carry feeding items in approved packaging, and follow any direction from the desk without delay. Report any change in the booking as soon as possible so the record stays current.

Please proceed to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for final review.
